scheme_name: Divyang Boys/ Girls Marriage Incentive Grant
other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India
Permanent resident of Uttarakhand or domiciled there for at least five years
Either the applicant or the partner must be a Person with Disabilities (PWD) with at least 40% disability
Applicant must not be convicted in any criminal case, including charges of molestation
Applicant must not be an income‑taxpayer
Applicant must not have a pre‑existing spouse (no pre‑existing wife for boys, no pre‑existing husband for girls)
Marriage must be solemnized according to prevailing social customs or by a competent court
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹25,000 to each eligible couple
